name-01.output: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?
name-01.direct: Lin Xiao, why did you come so early today?
name-01.reflect: 直译准确自然，'来得这么早'在英文口语中常用'come so early'或'so early today'表达，语气是日常问候，无需调整。
name-01.free: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?

context-01.output: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.
context-01.direct: Don't worry, I've already memorized it thoroughly.
context-01.reflect: 直译准确自然，'背熟了'意为已经熟记，英文用 memorized it 或 got it memorized 都地道，语气轻松安慰，无需改动。
context-01.free: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.

slang-01.output: That move was insane — I'm absolutely losing it.
slang-01.direct: This wave of operation is too showy, I directly split open.
slang-01.reflect: “这波操作”是网络用语，指这一系列举动/做法；“太秀了”意为太厉害/太骚；“裂开”是网络梗，表示震惊到崩溃、无语。直译完全不通，需要用地道英文表达震惊和佩服交织的反应。
slang-01.free: That move was insane — I'm absolutely losing it.

idiom-01.direct: This is simply drawing legs on a snake.
idiom-01.reflect: 直译保留了成语字面，但英文读者不懂这个典故，会一头雾水；英文里对应的习语是 gild the lily 或 overcomplicate things，语气上带点批评和无奈。

short-01.reflect: 原文是简短的应答词“嗯”，表示肯定或回应，直译“Yeah.”自然且符合口语习惯，语气也一致。

corpus-01.output: Teacher, I really did my homework—but the dog ate it.
corpus-01.direct: Teacher, I really did my homework but it was eaten by the dog.
corpus-01.reflect: 直译准确，但英文里 'the dog ate my homework' 本身就是众所周知的借口梗，语气和中文完全对应，只需让口语更自然。
corpus-01.free: Teacher, I really did my homework—but the dog ate it.

corpus-02.output: That head tilt was totally you sneaking a peek at the lines!
corpus-02.direct: That tilt of the head was stealing a look at the words!
corpus-02.reflect: 直译基本传达了意思，但 'stealing a look at the words' 稍显生硬，'偷看词' 指偷看台词/提词，英文口语常说 'peeking at the lines' 或 'sneaking a peek at the script'，语气是调侃揭穿，需保留。
corpus-02.free: That head tilt was totally you sneaking a peek at the lines!

corpus-03.output: Nah, I'm not dating. Keeping a little mystery is nice.
corpus-03.direct: Not dating, keeping a sense of mystery is pretty good.
corpus-03.reflect: “不处”是网络口语，指不处对象/不谈恋爱，直译成 not dating 准确；整句语气轻松随意，带点自我调侃，英文用 keeping it mysterious 更自然。
corpus-03.free: Nah, I'm not dating. Keeping a little mystery is nice.

corpus-04.reflect: 直译基本达意，但英文口语里表达'这么突然'更自然的说法是 'That's so sudden' 或 'So sudden?'，语气上带点惊讶和措手不及，用 'That's so sudden' 更地道。

corpus-05.output: LOL it's just too random—who even gets this question?
corpus-05.direct: It's just hahaha too abstract, who understands this question?
corpus-05.reflect: “太抽象了”是网络用语，指事情离谱、难以理解，不是字面的 abstract；语气是调侃加无奈。“谁懂啊”是流行语，表示共鸣/吐槽，不是真的问谁懂。
corpus-05.free: LOL it's just too random—who even gets this question?

corpus-06.output: Looks like it's true—I even came across some fan-shot clips from his concert.
corpus-06.direct: Seems like it's true, I even scrolled to his concert's leaked on-site videos.
corpus-06.reflect: 「刷到」是刷短视频/社交平台时刷到的意思，用 came across 更自然；「路透视频」指粉丝/路人拍的现场非官方视频，英文常说 fan-shot clips 或 leaked clips，这里用 fan-shot clips 更准确；「好像是真的」口语里说 It seems real 或 Looks like it's true 都行。
corpus-06.free: Looks like it's true—I even came across some fan-shot clips from his concert.

corpus-07.output: Which class meeting? How come I didn't hear about it?
corpus-07.direct: Which class meeting, how come I didn't hear it?
corpus-07.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'我怎么没听着'是口语化的反问，表达'我怎么不知道/没听说'，英文用 'How come I didn't hear about it?' 更自然，'class meeting' 对应'班会'没问题。
corpus-07.free: Which class meeting? How come I didn't hear about it?

corpus-08.output: Plus, his honest, down-to-earth vibe makes him so relatable. You're not losing out here—you might even score a free meal with that face.
corpus-08.direct: Besides, his honest and simple-minded aura is so approachable. You don't lose out this time. Maybe you can even mooch a meal with this face.
corpus-08.reflect: “憨厚老实”是褒义，指人朴实可靠，不是“simple-minded”（有点贬义），应译为 honest and down-to-earth；“亲民”指平易近人，用 relatable/approachable；“你这波不亏”是网络口语，意为这买卖你不吃亏，用 you're not losing out here；“蹭顿饭”是蹭饭、白吃一顿，用 score a free meal 更地道。
corpus-08.free: Plus, his honest, down-to-earth vibe makes him so relatable. You're not losing out here—you might even score a free meal with that face.

corpus-09.output: Should we throw this souvenir away?
corpus-09.direct: Should this souvenir be thrown away?
corpus-09.reflect: 直译准确自然，语气是日常询问，没有梗或俗语需要处理，英文口语中这样问完全地道。
corpus-09.free: Should we throw this souvenir away?

corpus-10.output: That's a pretty out-there idea you've got.
corpus-10.direct: Your this idea is also abstract enough.
corpus-10.reflect: 直译生硬且'abstract'在英文里不表达'离谱/清奇'的网络含义。'够抽象的'是网络梗，指想法离谱、清奇、让人无语，应意译为表达'离谱/脑回路清奇'的地道说法。
corpus-10.free: That's a pretty out-there idea you've got.

corpus-11.output: Fine, I'll deal with all this toxic motivational crap once I'm back in China.
corpus-11.direct: Alright, wait until I return to China to deal with these poisonous chicken soups.
corpus-11.reflect: "毒鸡汤" is internet slang for toxic motivational sayings—superficially inspiring but actually misleading/damaging. Literal "poisonous chicken soup" would confuse English viewers; the natural equivalent is "toxic motivational quotes" or "toxic positivity." "行" here is a casual agreement/acknowledgment, and "等我回国处理" means "once I'm back in China I'll deal with."
corpus-11.free: Fine, I'll deal with all this toxic motivational crap once I'm back in China.

corpus-12.output: That short? Hit a creative block?
corpus-12.direct: So short, did you hit a creative bottleneck?
corpus-12.reflect: 直译准确传达了字面意思和调侃语气。'creative bottleneck' 在英文中常用，但口语里更自然、更带调侃的说法是 'creative block' 或 'writer's block'。
corpus-12.free: That short? Hit a creative block?

corpus-14.output: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT—which one comes out on top?
corpus-14.direct: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT, who is more superior?
corpus-14.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'更胜一筹'是成语，英文里用'come out on top'或'win'更自然；'vs.'在口语中可保留，但整体需要更像英语母语者的提问方式。
corpus-14.free: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT—which one comes out on top?

corpus-15.output: Just look at that smug, trying-to-be-profound look on his face—you know something's fishy. That kind of straight-faced nonsense is comedy gold.
corpus-15.direct: Look at that deliberately profound expression of his and you know there's a catch—this kind of deadpan nonsense has the best comedic effect.
corpus-15.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'有猫腻'直译成there's a catch稍显生硬，英文更常说something's fishy；'故作高深'用deliberately profound不够地道，putting on an air of profundity更自然；'一本正经的胡说八道'是固定说法，deadpan nonsense或straight-faced bullshit能传达调侃语气。
corpus-15.free: Just look at that smug, trying-to-be-profound look on his face—you know something's fishy. That kind of straight-faced nonsense is comedy gold.

corpus-16.output: Oh man, why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you post sunrise photos on Moments every day.

corpus-16.free: Oh man, why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you post sunrise photos on Moments every day.

corpus-17.direct: Not dating, these days love is all clearly priced.
corpus-17.reflect: “不处”是网络口语，意为“不谈恋爱/不处对象”；“明码标价”指爱情被标上价格、变得物质化。直译基本达意，但“clearly priced”稍显生硬，英文里说 love has a price tag 更地道自然。
corpus-17.free: Not dating. These days, love comes with a price tag.

corpus-18.output: Not interested. Go play by yourself.
corpus-18.direct: No deal, go play by yourself.

corpus-18.free: Not interested. Go play by yourself.

corpus-19.direct: Look, the lottery winning numbers I bought are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.

corpus-19.free: Look, the numbers on the lottery ticket I bought are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.

corpus-20.output: Hakimi north-south green beans — I'm dying trying not to laugh at my desk.
corpus-20.direct: Hakimi north-south green beans, I've held it in at my workstation until I got internal injuries.
corpus-20.reflect: "哈基米南北绿豆" is an internet meme/nonsense phrase (from a viral cat video song), not meant literally; "憋出内伤" means suppressing laughter/emotion so hard it hurts inside. Need to convey the meme vibe and the feeling of barely holding back laughter at one's desk.
corpus-20.free: Hakimi north-south green beans — I'm dying trying not to laugh at my desk.

corpus-21.free: Ran into this guy on the subway who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole ride.

corpus-22.output: I stayed up late last night watching your livestream and laughed so hard my stomach hurt.

corpus-22.reflect: 直译准确传达了意思，'laughed until my stomach hurt' 是英语中自然的表达，语气轻松口语化，无需改动。
corpus-22.free: I stayed up late last night watching your livestream and laughed so hard my stomach hurt.

corpus-23.output: Was in such a hurry to leave that I grabbed the rag and brought it to the office thinking it was my towel.

corpus-23.free: Was in such a hurry to leave that I grabbed the rag and brought it to the office thinking it was my towel.

corpus-24.output: Not looking for a relationship—this drama's too much for me to handle.
corpus-24.direct: Not dating, the melon is too big to bite through.
corpus-24.reflect: “不处”是网络用语，指不处对象/不谈恋爱；“瓜”是网络吃瓜梗，指八卦事件；“啃不动”比喻事情太复杂难以消化。直译会让英文观众完全看不懂，需要意译出“不谈恋爱，这瓜太大吃不下”的真实含义。

corpus-27.output: Isn't that how it should be?

corpus-28.output: The boss is marrying the cleaning lady.

corpus-28.free: The boss is marrying the cleaning lady.

corpus-29.output: Treadmill, elliptical, or spin bike—which is better for heavier people trying to lose fat?

corpus-29.free: Treadmill, elliptical, or spin bike—which is better for heavier people trying to lose fat?

corpus-31.free: Oh man, I can't even—I'm gonna be laughing about this for a whole year. Come on, everyone's got at least one embarrassing period-pad-buying story that made them want to disappear!

corpus-32.free: I'm already running a fever—please, aunties, just leave me alone.

corpus-34.free: I keep getting interrupted by all kinds of messages at work and find it hard to focus. Any tips for improving efficiency?

corpus-38.free: I was scrolling through videos and saw this Shandong street vendor lady making a giant jianbing guozi, and it got me wondering—is Shandong jianbing the biggest in the whole country?

corpus-40.output: I can't even—this is too much good news all at once.

corpus-40.free: I can't even—this is too much good news all at once.

corpus-41.output:
Others: a fierce white-browed tiger.
Me: a Qiaolezi ice cream bar.

corpus-41.free:
Others: a fierce white-browed tiger.
Me: a Qiaolezi ice cream bar.
